entities.name: Émile-Louis Burnouf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Émile-Louis Burnouf was a leading nineteenth-century Orientalist and racialist author of Aryanism. He was a professor at the faculté des lettres at Nancy University, then principal of the French School at Athens from 1867–1875. He was also the author of a Sanskrit-French dictionary.
